title: FCFS example: CPU burst times
purpose: Provide exact input process burst data for two FCFS schedules.
alt: 동시에 도착한 P1·P2·P3의 CPU burst 시간이 각각 24·3·3ms인 FCFS 입력 예시
requiredChecks: Input data only; no schedule implied by table row order.
Units milliseconds and process identifiers unambiguous.
prompt: Create an ORIGINAL English raster technical figure for an IT reference blog. Opaque white background, navy highly readable type, restrained blue/teal/amber, flat design, generous margins. Exact data and labels only, no logos/copying textbook composition. Title 'FCFS example: CPU burst times'. Large two-column table Process | CPU burst (ms), rows P1|24, P2|3, P3|3. Subtitle 'All arrive at time 0'. Footer 'The selected arrival order determines the FCFS schedule'. Clean original data table, no Gantt or extra numbers.
